name: Solid-State / Mechanochemical Synthesis - Bulk Oxide or Nitride
description: Dry precursors are blended and milled, then reacted in a kiln without a solvent. Covers ceramic mixed oxides and perovskites, hexagonal boron nitride and the thermal polymerization of urea or melamine to g-C3N4.
source: Campanati, Fornasari and Vaccari, Fundamentals in the preparation of heterogeneous catalysts, Catal. Today 77, 299 (2003); Wang et al., Nature Mater. 7, 76 (2008), g-C3N4; Grant et al., Science 354, 1570 (2016), boron nitride
route_note: No filtration, no drying and no nitrate off-gas. Milling time, not kiln time, is usually the cost driver.
